audit_agent: Agent 6: Modal Interception & Allow Hunter Engineer
mandate: Audit modal dialog interception, Allow button detection, and PID decoupling across test suites.

find_allow_dialogs.description: Scans process and system top-level windows; filters by DIALOG_CLASS_NAME (#32770) or ALLOW_TEXT_KEYWORDS in title/static texts; scans child controls for buttons with text in ALLOW_BUTTON_KEYWORDS; falls back to static text search and OK button discovery; returns list of candidate window metadata.

handle_allow_dialogs.description: Multi-tier acceptance loop: (1) BM_CLICK (0x00F5) to button HWND, (2) WM_COMMAND with (BN_CLICKED << 16) | btn_id, (3) pywinauto click fallback, (4) Polling loop verifying dialog window destruction.

clean_teardown_mechanism.description: Teardown in close() dispatches WM_CLOSE to main_hwnd, followed by WM_SYSCOMMAND with SC_CLOSE (0xF060) and WM_CLOSE to all process windows, fallback Alt+F4 via pywinauto, and clean exit polling before timeout force termination.

findings: Zero test suites assert hardcoded dead PIDs against running system processes.
Milestone evidence suites (test_step128, test_step129, test_step130, test_step131, test_step132) validate archived checkpoint JSON files using cscape_pid > 0 checks.

Active live suites (test_step133, test_step134, test_step135, test_step136, test_step137, test_step138, test_step139, test_step140) dynamically resolve active PID and HWND from artifacts/.cscape_live_gate.json via src.cscape.gate and gracefully skip via pytest.skip() if the gate is offline or process does not exist.

Decoupled test_real_lifecycle.py: Renamed TestCscapeRealLifecycle to TestLiveCscapeRealLifecycle with test_live_* methods, ensuring pytest -k 'not live' cleanly deselects all live GUI tests without spawning or killing running Cscape processes.
